description: Return the current TOON hypermedia representation and valid links of a task entity offered to you, or the view of its plan or epic.

scope.description: Optional explicit scope discriminator (inferred from plan_id/epic_id/entity when omitted).

plan_id.description: Identifier of the target plan scope, or the literal NO_PLAN for the project's workspace scope, or for the machine scope where the worker's task is of the machine scope (resolved from the job record). Exactly one of plan_id or epic_id is required (server-enforced).

epic_id.description: Identifier of the target epic scope. Mutually exclusive with plan_id.

entity.description: Optional entity identifier: a task entity as its offer names it, such as 'envelope-1', 'F-12', 'enrich-core', or a consultation_id (a worker may name only an entity offered to it, server-enforced); with plan_id NO_PLAN also an entry_id its offer names.
